liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Leaf Of Fall** (2 reviews, 1 other source): A crossfade now covers five seconds of this song that earlier copies had cut; The reviewer says this song holds the only remaining cut in the recording [1][6][7]

## Setlist highlights

- **The River**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **Comes A Time**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **Kansas City Star**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 5 archived performances [8]
- **The Stallion, Pt. 4**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 14 archived performances [8]
- **In My Eyes**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **It's Gonna Be (Alright)**: rare: 11 archived performances [8]
- **Mutilated Lips**: back after 41 archived shows (673 days) [8]
- **Broken Down Ragged Ford**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- Earliest performances in the archive: She's Your Baby, Exactly Where I'm At, Sorry Charlie, The Enabler [8]

## The recordings

- **ween1999-04-28.SBD-MKV4** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 48 songs; 271 min [1]
- **Ween1999-04-28**: source not stated; 48 songs; 274 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **jwg-1999-04-28-saint-asbury-park-nj**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 1 songs; 272 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]

## Around the show

- Guests: Mean Ween on vocals [1]
- Gener and Chris Harford played an acoustic set; listed players include Dean Ween, Claude Coleman Jr., Dave Dreiwitz, Rev. B-ill Fowler and Glenn McClelland [1]
- Gener and Chris Harford played an acoustic set with Dean Ween, Claude Coleman Jr., Dave Dreiwitz, Rev. B-ill Fowler and Glenn McClelland [2]
- Made from master DATs to remove disc-change cuts present in versions circulating for 21 years [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween1999-04-28.SBD-MKV4**: taped by ProDigital; transferred by Funk It Blog; source: SBD > ??? > WAV + last 90 minutes from Schoeps MK4V > master DAT > WAV (untracked) [1]
- **Ween1999-04-28**: taped by Pepper; transferred by Pepper; source: FOB Schoeps mk4s > VMS 02IB > SBM-1 > D8 @ 44.1kHz [2]. Also: Front-of-board Schoeps mk4s via VMS 02IB and SBM-1 to D8 DAT at 44.1kHz, then retracked to FLAC; The reviewer says he taped the show; this redux was tracked from original DATs to remove disc flips [2][6]
- **jwg-1999-04-28-saint-asbury-park-nj**: source: SBD/Schoeps 4V [3]. Also: First three hours come from the soundboard; the final 90 minutes from the Schoeps 4V master DAT; The reviewer says he taped the show; this redux was tracked from original DATs to remove disc flips [3][7]
